title: Encoded configuration vector
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $s,V,t$ be natural numbers. Define the vector string by encoding, in order for each $a<V$, the binary representation of the value of the bounded dynamic-programming computation for $N$ on $x$ at parameters $s,V,t,a$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
caveat: The upstream definitions of the dynamic-programming value and word encoding are omitted, so the exact meaning of the computed value is not specified here.
